name: AT-rich interaction domain 4B
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II
negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: ARID4B encodes AT-rich interactive domain-containing protein 4B. Annotated molecular activities include transcription cis-regulatory region binding. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and negative regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.
